notes.title: 🎉 Price Drop to Celebrate the Release of Our New Project!
notes.notes:
Dear friends!

To celebrate the release of our new game Digger: Galactic Treasures, we've lowered the price of our previous project! It's a great chance to explore the unique worlds we've created and get to know our work.



💥 If you haven’t played it yet — now’s the perfect time!

Thank you for your support! 🚀

notes.title: Turbo Sloths Major Update #2!!!
notes.notes:
💥Dear Friends, The big update #2 is here

🎉 New features & capabilities: 
Added the Korean localisation
Added the support for Vulkan
Rebalanced the career, as well as made necessary changes to the in-game economics
Added a new race at the very start of your career. 
Active Gas Acceleration has been given a boost
Added a setting that allows you to switch between special events (e.g. St. Valentine’s Day, Easter, Halloween)
Added a setting to disable popping up messages from fans
Added new special events (i.e. St. Valentine’s Day, Easter, Halloween)
Added a setting to toggle the display of volumetric clouds
Added a few extra graphics settings

🔧Bugfixes & improvements: 
Fixed an issue with certain sounds, which could not be turned off, or these were triggered improperly
Fixed a bug with Overheating: It did not accelerate the vehicle to the desired extent
Fixed a bug with replenishing ammunition upon killing the Turtle war bot
Destroying Turbojunks now slightly refills your ammunition
Fixed an issue that required an online status in Steam (Requirement has now been removed)
Changed a few default parameters for a smoother and a more comfortable start in the career
Improved weight values for certain objects
Improved collision for certain traps
Fixed a number of critical bugs
Fixed critical bugs in the ‘Split screen’ mode
Improved helper bot spawning for the ‘Split screen’ mode
Outside the Arena encounters, bots will no longer use rockets.

All of the above fixes and improvements have been made thanks to your comments and suggestions. Thank you very much for your interest and dedication to our game! We work hard to make it look and work better and smoother!

🚀We wish you a highly enjoyable gaming experience!!!🚀

notes.title: Turbo Sloths + DLC Major Update!!!
notes.notes:
A massive update is finally here!

We are thrilled to announce the release of the first substantial update for Turbo Sloths! We extend our heartfelt thanks to all who have provided feedback, as well as those eagerly awaiting this update. Your support has been instrumental in improving the game and making it even more entertaining! A big thank you to all - this release is a collective achievement.

[previewyoutube=BrpcnCrPWbU;full][/previewyoutube]

The update includes the following:

A significant graphical overhaul.
All locations have undergone extensive enhancements. This has significantly improved both the game's visuals and performance. The update also optimises video memory consumption, benefiting players with less powerful GPUs.

New vehicles.
We've added two new vehicles: a Pick-Up and a UFO, complete with corresponding parts for upgrades and customisation. Each new vehicle boasts unique abilities to diversify gameplay.

Improved handling.
We've substantially improved handling, making it more responsive and beginner-friendly. We hope you'll appreciate it.

New 'Quick Race' modes.
These new modes involve shooting targets on the go and battling bosses - minor additions, but highly entertaining.

Other minor improvements include:

 Fine-tuned bot behaviour.
 In-game tips (can be disabled in the settings menu).
 The option to select the IRIS ability in the Garage.
 Numerous bug fixes.
 Enhanced overall game stability and performance.



We also want to express our gratitude to all the supporters who eagerly anticipated the promised DLC, which includes:

 A new career stage, a whole new area with a boss, and 36 unique challenging races.
 A new arena to decimate war bots.
 A new weapon - the heavy machine gun.
 A new and final stage, packed with 8 ruthless decisive races to bring the Wasteland League and the story to a close.
 


A DEMO is now available for download so you can see what you, as racers, are truly capable of.

Thank you very much for your attention! Special thanks to the fans who have been continuously following our progress on the project. We appreciate it immensely!

notes.title: Turbo Sloths gamedev update
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! The time is here to share a piece of news about the development progress.
We have gone through many milestones developing our project.

What has been done?
1. We have built our own physical models for the in-game vehicles and made improvements to handling and on-track stability. 

2. Sloth character backgrounds and artworks have been created. Our team has chosen to make 2D character modesl in order to accelerate the process and make them stand out and be memorable. We intend to create 3D models for these characters. Time shall tell, what’s coming next, but now, we’d like you to meet Joe, the mechanic, and Sue, a hot-tempered young lady in the races. These two are dying to meet you as well.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38970760/a01c1b5bc3989bfd918320151fe2baa28e08c0ee.png

3. As of now, three racing tracks and the tutorial have been designed from the ground up. ːsteamhappyː

4. We have launched a dedicated Discord channel (https://discord.gg/KCs5Dg5X) and a Twitter account (https://twitter.com/Tsloths). You’re welcome to join our new-born community, where you may get a chance to win a game key, provided that you’re actively engaged in conversation and discussion.

What are we currently engaged in?
We are now polishing racing modes, statistics, etc.

Apart from that, we are also designing the garage and vehicle customization capability.

The work on bots for the races has kicked in. Thanks to the new fellow in our team, the entire process should now run even better.
